capabilities.ownership: Windows kernel mutex and shared owner mapping in the signed-in user desktop session. Filesystem coordination failed across process views and was replaced; diagnostic JSON mirrors are not authority.
capabilities.session_rules: Private tokens gate launch, selection/focus, selected capture, controller attachment, input and caller cleanup. Atomic acquire, 5–120-second lease, renew/release. Wrong/stale tokens cannot stop another owner. Expiry/cancellation retain the reservation until actual in-flight work and neutral cleanup finish. F12 and tray Stop remain local emergency controls.
capabilities.window_observations: Read-only list_game_windows includes PID, process birth/path, native client and screen bounds, foreground identities, UTC and monotonic timestamps; unavailable process data is explicit. New window_observations samples foreground for 0–10000 ms at requested 100–2000 ms intervals, plus inventories before/after. No session token, focus, selection, screenshots or input. Sequential sampling can miss transitions.
capabilities.capture: observe_game and capture_after return a PNG plus identity/geometry/timing receipt. Physical-monitor clipping preserves client canvas positions as black padding, with clipped/incomplete/missing_native_pixels/visible_client_regions and exact image_to_client_scale. Identity/geometry changes reject capture; minimized windows reject. Occlusion is included; captures are not atomic render-frame measurements.
capabilities.cloud_queue: Window inventory/sampling may overlap launch/control. A second control action remains excluded; normal calls leave a coordination slot within the companion's four-command limit.
